name: Half-Elf
description: Walking in two worlds but truly belonging to neither, half-elves combine what some say are the best qualities of their elf and human parents: human curiosity, inventiveness, and ambition tempered by the refined senses, love of nature, and artistic tastes of the elves.

features.name: Age
features.description: Half-elves age at much the same rate as humans, reaching adulthood at the age of 20. They live much longer than humans, however, often exceeding 180 years.
features.snippet: Half-elves reach adulthood at 20 and often exceed 180 years.

features.name: Size
features.description: Half-elves are more or less the same size as humans, ranging from 5 to 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
features.snippet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Humanity's Hope
features.description: When you take the Prepare move during a rest, choose one of your allies to gain an additional Heroic Inspiration.
features.snippet: When you take the Prepare move during a rest, choose one ally to gain an additional Heroic Inspiration.

features.name: Elven Lineage
features.description:
Choose one of the following Lineages:
- **Elven Pride (High Elf Lineage).** When you succeed an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you may take a Stress to gain advantage on your next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw within 1 minute.
- **Uncanny Reactions (Wood Elf Lineage).** When you roll Initiative, you may expend a Heroic Inspiration to make the result your maximum possible value. This can only be done if you haven't rolled yet.
features.snippet: Choose one lineage: Elven Pride (High Elf) or Uncanny Reactions (Wood Elf).

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can read, speak, and write Common, Elvish, and one language of your choice.
features.snippet: You can read, speak, and write Common, Elvish, and one language of your choice.
